# openstatus_status_page (Data Source)

Fetches an existing OpenStatus status page by ID. Returns all status page attributes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openstatus_status_page" "main" {
  id = "456"
}

output "status_page_slug" {
  value = data.openstatus_status_page.main.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the status page.

### Read-Only

- `title` (String) Title of the status page.
- `slug` (String) URL slug of the status page.
- `description` (String) Description of the status page.
- `homepage_url` (String) Homepage URL.
- `contact_url` (String) Contact page URL.
- `icon` (String) Icon image URL.
- `custom_domain` (String) Custom domain for the status page.
- `access_type` (String) Access control type (`public`, `password`, or `email-domain`).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Status page password.
- `auth_email_domains` (List of String) Allowed email domains.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the status page is published.
- `theme` (String) The theme of the status page.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the status page was created.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the status page was last updated.
